why: Deletions a reviewer has judged superseded, keyed by the deleted path.
`node local/sync/post-sync.mjs` inventories the exported surface of every deleted fork-only module
and fails when an export has no surviving reference. That is the right default: a module disappearing
is exactly when a caller can leave with it. This file is how a reviewed supersession is recorded so
the check can pass without weakening it.
Each entry must name the live replacement and the evidence for calling it a superset — the check
prints this, so the next sync inherits the reasoning instead of re-deriving it.
An entry whose path is no longer deleted is reported as stale, so this file cannot rot unnoticed.
Entries are therefore per sync: a previous sync's acknowledgements are pruned once their deletion is
no longer part of the tip..HEAD range.

src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journ.reason: The fork added text-only editing of a queued message; upstream landed the same compare-and-set decision in `queued-message-update.ts` and made it a superset — it edits images as well as text, refuses an image card the caller was shown no images for (`readsImageCards`), and returns the previous body so the caller can publish a diff. Its `queued-message-update.spec.ts` carries the retry/superseded cases the fork spec held, and both live callers were re-pointed (`journal-queued-messages.ts` `update()`, `structured-agent-session-wire/structured-agent-session-queued-edit.ts`), so the feature kept its surface and its callers.

src/renderer/src/components/settings/acc.reason: The fork rendered the MiniMax section from the shared accounts model; upstream replaced it with a self-contained `MiniMaxAccountsSection` component that owns its own credential state through `useMiniMaxCredentials(host.owner)` and reports where the credential is stored, for the host the pane is showing. The fork's contribution on top of it — the per-provider enable switch — now wraps that component in `AccountsPane.tsx`, and `AccountsPane.test.tsx` pins both the switch and the switched-off notice for it.
